  • Bestial Fury

  • Companion's Bond

  • Darkvision

  • Eight Legged Waltz

    Whenever you start your turn on a web surface, you now gain extra Movement Speed and become Resistant to ⁠Poison.

    Can Dash, Disengage, and Help with bonus actions.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Prey's Scent

    You deal an additional 1d6 damage to targets marked by your ranger.

    Not slowed or enwebbed by web surfaces.

Companion_GiantSpider_11
Aranea Aculeata is a spider summoned via a Beast Master's  Wolf Spider Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Aranea Aculeata is the fully upgraded form of  Aranea and  Aranea Major once the Beast Master has reached level 11.

2d10⁠Piercing

 Range: Self

Remove  Burning,  Downed,  Ensnared,  Entangled,  Enwebbed,  Prone,  Sleeping.

1d8 + 4⁠Piercing

 Web ()

 DEX Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)

Because of the  Prey's Scent passive, Beast Master rangers may wish to attack the target marked by  Hunter's Mark for optimal damage.
